name: Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China (2020)
authority: National People's Congress Standing Committee; administered by MOFCOM
requirements: Licensing for listed and temporarily controlled items (Art. 9, 12); outright or destination bans (Art. 10); importer/end-user control list (Art. 18); reaches foreign parties (Art. 44) and re-exports (Art. 45); reciprocal measures (Art. 48).
penalties: Fines of 5-10x illegal turnover above RMB 500k, else RMB 0.5-5m; suspension or revocation of export qualification.

name: Regulations of the PRC on Export Control of Dual-Use Items (State Council Decree No. 792)
requirements: Single (≤1 yr), general (≤3 yr) and registration-voucher licences; 45-working-day review with exceptions; control list measures; extraterritorial Art. 49 for foreign-made items containing Chinese-origin items. No numeric threshold in the Decree.

name: China Dual-Use Items Export Control List (Announcement 2024 No. 51)
authority: MOFCOM, MIIT, GACC, State Cryptography Administration
requirements: Unified control list from 1 Dec 2024; repealed 11 earlier notices incl. Ga/Ge (2023 No. 23), graphite (2023 No. 39) and antimony (2024 No. 33), whose items continue under the list. Updated by later announcements (e.g. 2025 Nos. 10, 18).

name: China export licensing of high-purity synthetic and natural flake graphite (Announcement 2023 No. 39)
requirements: Licences for >99.9% purity high-strength high-density synthetic graphite and natural flake graphite products; notice repealed 1 Dec 2024 with items moved into the unified list; US exports subject to stricter end-use review under 2024 No. 46, suspended to 27 Nov 2026.

name: China export licensing of antimony and superhard materials (Announcement 2024 No. 33)
requirements: Announced 15 Aug 2024, effective 15 Sep 2024; notice repealed 1 Dec 2024 with items carried into the unified list.

name: China export controls on tungsten, tellurium, bismuth, molybdenum and indium items (Announcement 2025 No. 10)
requirements: Licences incl. for indium phosphide, trimethylindium and triethylindium. Not named in the Nov 2025 suspensions.

name: China export controls on seven medium and heavy rare earths (Announcement 2025 No. 18)
requirements: Licences for Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Lu, Sc, Y metals, alloys, targets, oxides and compounds, incl. sputtering targets. Not covered by the Nov 2025 suspension.

name: China October 2025 export control package: superhard materials, rare-earth equipment, five more rare earths, batteries/graphite anodes (Announcements 2025 Nos. 55-58)
requirements: Would have controlled diamond wire saws, grinding wheels, DC arc plasma CVD and Ho, Er, Tm, Eu, Yb items from 8 Nov 2025; all suspended 7 Nov 2025 to 10 Nov 2026.

name: China export control on rare-earth technologies (Announcement 2025 No. 62)
requirements: Controls rare-earth mining, separation, metallurgy, magnet and recycling technology and bars substantive help to such activities abroad; suspended to 10 Nov 2026.

name: Provisions on the Unreliable Entity List (MOFCOM Order 2020 No. 4)
requirements: Lists foreign entities that endanger China's interests or cut off/discriminate against Chinese firms; measures: trade, investment, entry bans, fines; Chinese firms need approval to deal with listed entities.

name: UEL listing of TechInsights and 13 US defence entities (UEL Working Mechanism Announcement 2025 No. 10)
requirements: Bans import/export and new investment in China and bans Chinese parties from transacting with or sending data to TechInsights and affiliates; suspension status unknown.

name: Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law of the People's Republic of China (2021)
authority: National People's Congress Standing Committee; implemented by State Council departments
requirements: Countermeasure list with asset freezes and transaction bans; Art. 12 bans implementing foreign discriminatory measures and allows damages suits.

name: MOFCOM anti-discrimination investigation into US integrated-circuit measures (Announcement 2025 No. 50)
authority: MOFCOM Trade Remedy and Investigation Bureau
requirements: Investigation under Foreign Trade Law Art. 7, 36-37 of US tariffs, export controls, CHIPS Act limits and Huawei Ascend guidance; normally 3 months; outcome unknown.

name: China anti-dumping investigation of dichlorosilane from Japan (Announcements 2026 No. 2 and No. 37)
authority: MOFCOM Trade Remedy and Investigation Bureau
requirements: Initiated 7 Jan 2026; provisional deposits from 8 Sep 2026: Shin-Etsu 99.2%, Denal Silane 80.8%, others 99.2%.

name: MOFCOM Measures for Industrial and Supply Chain Security Investigations (Announcement 2026 No. 24)
requirements: Investigations of foreign measures or firms harming China's supply chains, with remedies incl. trade bans, special fees, countermeasure listing and investment bans.

name: MOFCOM whistleblower regime for strategic-mineral dual-use export violations (Announcement 2026 No. 26)
requirements: Reporting channel and rewards for unlicensed exports, splitting to evade licensing, third-country rerouting and dealing with listed end users.

name: MOFCOM ban on dual-use exports to Japanese military end users (Announcement 2026 No. 1)
requirements: Bans all dual-use exports to Japanese military users/uses and any user/use that raises Japan's military strength, with liability for third-country transfers.

name: MOFCOM export-control control list designations of US rare-earth producers (Announcement 2026 No. 23)
requirements: Bans dual-use exports and third-country transfers of Chinese-origin dual-use items to 10 US entities incl. MP Materials and USA Rare Earth.

name: MOFCOM export prohibition on Nexperia China (4 October 2025)
requirements: Prohibited Nexperia China and subcontractors from exporting specific finished components and sub-assemblies made in China; exemptions for qualifying (civilian) exports from 1 Nov 2025; formal withdrawal unknown. Notice text not found online.
